rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 248, 225), rgb(30, 24, 4)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 576px; height: 1px; padding-top: 721px; margin-left: 26px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
CHECK users
first_name y first_lastname: 2 a 30 caracteres; second_*: 1 a 30
status IN ('ACTIVO', 'INACTIVO')
email = lower(email) y con formato de correo
CHECK password_reset_codes: attempts >= 0

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 248, 225), rgb(30, 24, 4)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 576px; height: 1px; padding-top: 721px; margin-left: 706px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
CHECK pending_registrations
mismas reglas de nombres y correo que users
attempts >= 0 · codes_sent >= 1
Sin FK: el usuario aún no existe; al verificar el código se crea en users

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 248, 225), rgb(30, 24, 4)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 576px; height: 1px; padding-top: 681px; margin-left: 1386px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
CHECK roles
name ~ '^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{1,29}$' y name <> 'DETAILS'
description: 3 a 200 caracteres
CHECK permissions
name ~ '^ms[0-9]{2}:[a-z][a-z0-9_]*:[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$'

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1932px; height: 1px; padding-top: 833px; margin-left: 28px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 10px; font-family: Helvetica; color: var(--ge-adaptive-fg, #000000); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Convenciones
PK clave primaria · FK clave foránea (subrayada) · UQ única · las FK de role_permissions son ON DELETE CASCADE; las demás, NO ACTION · user_roles y role_permissions resuelven las relaciones N:M (users–roles y roles–permissions) con PK compuesta
Triggers: trg_protect_system_roles (un rol is_system no se borra, no se renombra ni cambia su marca) · trg_check_role_permissions (diferido al commit: todo rol conserva ms01:profile:read y ms01:session:logout; ESTUDIANTE y ADMIN, ms01:profile:write; ms01:role:manage solo y siempre en ADMIN) · trg_users_updated_at y trg_roles_updated_at (set_updated_at)
Índices: idx_users_email_trgm (GIN pg_trgm sobre email) · idx_users_status (status) · idx_user_roles_role (role_id, user_id) · idx_role_permissions_permission (permission_id) · idx_users_valid_from y idx_roles_valid_from (parciales, valid_from IS NOT NULL) · idx_password_reset_codes_user (user_id, expires_at) · idx_pending_registrations_expires (expires_at)
Motor: PostgreSQL 17 en local (docker compose) y Amazon RDS PostgreSQL 18 en la nube (una base por entorno)
